audited.en: Team Bridge is on for you
audited.verdict: PASS all locales. 'Team Bridge' kept in Latin, as a statement of fact (est activé / está activado / 已为你开启 / включён / đã được bật / فعال ہے / चालू है), not a question or an offer. audited.en: This notice could not be dismissed. Try again.
